title: Lazurio application preparation declaration
description: Declared in an application package.json under `lazurio.preparation`. Says how the application is prepared before its single-process start (Lazurio Module Standard, manual/module-standard.md, decision 0171). Scripts name package scripts, never shell commands.

runtime.description: Toolchain that installs dependencies and runs the scripts: `bun` (default; frozen install from bun.lock beside owner_package) or `uv` (Python; `uv sync --frozen` from uv.lock, scripts run through `uv run`).

uv_version.description: Exact uv version the Environment must provide when runtime is `uv`.

owner_package.description: Module-relative POSIX path of the package that owns the preparation (usually the application package itself); no traversal.

prepare_script.description: Optional idempotent package script that does everything the start must not: client build, data generation, symlinks, migrations.

check_script.description: Read-only package script that exits 0 when the application is prepared and non-zero otherwise.
